name: MS200
summary: MS200 is a compact single-line dToF LiDAR offered by Orbbec for cleaning-robot navigation and mapping. It provides 360-degree ranging in a low-profile housing and is documented in a commercial self-cleaning robot. The manufacturer specification gives a 12 m range at 90% reflectivity and configurable scan speed.
